parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Hello, City Swim School.

Oh, hello. I wanted to ask about swimming lessons. That’s in a class not individual.

Right. Well, we do group lessons at various levels. To start off with, we have what we call the water babies class. That’s for babies of three months and over.

Really, as young as that.

Yes, that’s really the best time to start.

Right. Well, we do have a baby, so I’ll make a note of that. What do they actually do in the lessons?

Well, the main aim is just to familiarize them with the water, so they feel at ease there. They get the children to enjoy themselves. They have lots of toys and things they can use to play with in the water.

Right. And how much do the lessons cost?

They’re held on Tuesday mornings and each lesson costs £3.80. It’s not really a course as such.

Okay. Well, I’ll talk to my wife about that. But I was actually ringing about lessons for me.

Okay. So, are you a beginner?

Not exactly, but I’m not very good.

Well, the beginners' classes are really for people who don’t have any experience of swimming. They aim to teach you techniques for breathing in the water, and they get you to do things like put your head underwater and open your eyes.

Okay. I can do that.

And by the end of the course, they aim to have you swimming 5 metres.

I think I can probably just about do that.

Okay. So, you’d be better in the intermediate class then. That’s where you learn the main swimming strokes: Front stroke, back stroke and so on.

What about diving?

Yes, they teach you how to do that. And you’d also do some underwater swimming.

Not with a tank or anything?

Oh no, not scuba. Just ordinary underwater swimming. And in the intermediate course, you also look at water safety, both in the pool and when swimming in other places.

Okay. Well, that sounds the right level for me, I think. So, how much does that cost?

61 pounds for a course. That’s 10 lessons.

Can you tell me a bit more about the class? How many people would there be in it?

Well, the intermediate class is usually around 8 to 10. That’s what we aim at, though occasionally it might go up to 12.

Okay, that sounds quite a reasonable size, not too many. And the class is for adults, is it?

Yes.

Okay. And just out of interest, is there an advanced class?

Yes, they focus on developing more efficient swimming techniques and on working on your speed. And they also prepare you for competitive swimming.

Okay. Now, I think I’d want to start with the intermediate one, really.

Now, is there anything special I need to know?

Well, the classes are on Tuesdays and the first lesson is on January the 13th.

So, you need to register before then. January the 8th is the latest, but it’s filling up quickly, so I'd do it straight away. You can pick up a form here or get one off the internet.

And classes are at 7.30pm.

Right.

Then I just roll up with my swimming trunks. Do I have to bring my own towel?

That’s right. We provide all participants with a swimming hat, though.

Oh, I don’t usually wear one.

Well, we do insist on it, actually. It helps the instructor to identify you, apart from anything else. Oh, and don’t forget you need a 20p coin for the locker.

Oh, okay. Right. Well, I’ve been meaning to do this for ages. I really need to get some more exercise, and everyone says swimming is good for your health.

Yes. And a lot of people find it improves their confidence, too. And of course, it could save your life, or even someone else’s.

That’s right. Okay. Well, thanks very much. Goodbye.

Goodbye.

analyses.content: 针对婴儿班，工作人员解释其主要目的是让孩子熟悉水性，因此会提供大量的 toys（玩具）让他们在水中玩耍。

Well, the main aim is just to familiarize them with the water, so they feel at ease there. They get the children to enjoy themselves. They have lots of toys and things they can use to play with in the water。
听到 water babies 定位后，注意卷面的 using 对应原文的 can use to play with。

Well, the beginners' classes are really for people who don’t have any experience of swimming. They aim to teach you techniques for breathing in the water, and they get you to do things like put your head underwater and open your eyes。
听到 beginner 后，紧跟在 teach you techniques for... 之后的动名词就是答案词。
初学者课程（Beginners）侧重基础，主要教授如何在水中进行 breathing（呼吸）以及练习在水下睁眼。
Okay. So, you’d be better in the intermediate class then. That’s where you learn the main swimming strokes: Front stroke, back stroke and so on. What about diving? Yes, they teach you how to do that。
这是一个由客户主动提问（What about...?）引出的答案，听到工作人员回答 Yes 时确认记录。
在中级班（Intermediate）中，除了学习基本的泳姿，学员还会接触到 diving（跳水/潜水）和普通的水下游泳。
Oh no, not scuba. Just ordinary underwater swimming. And in the intermediate course, you also look at water safety, both in the pool and when swimming in other places。
听到 intermediate course 的后续内容，寻找卷面 in the water 对应的原文表达 water safety。
中级班非常注重实用性，课程内容包含了在各种水域环境下的 safety（安全）教育。

Well, the intermediate class is usually around 8 to 10. That’s what we aim at, though occasionally it might go up to 12. Okay, that sounds quite a reasonable size, not too many. And the class is for adults, is it? Yes。
听到数字 8 to 10 或 12 之后，紧接着出现的身份名词即为答案。
客户在询问班级人数后，顺便确认了该课程的受众群体是 adults（成年人）。
高级班（Advanced）的重点在于提升游泳技巧的效率，并针对学员的 speed（速度）进行专项强化训练。
Yes, they focus on developing more efficient swimming techniques and on working on your speed. And they also prepare you for competitive swimming。
听到 advanced class 定位。卷面的 improving 对应原文中的 working on your...。
Well, the classes are on Tuesdays and the first lesson is on January the 13th. So, you need to register before then. January the 8th is the latest, but it’s filling up quickly...
高能日期干扰！ 录音中先出现了 January the 8th，但那是“截止注册时间（the latest）”，千万不能填错，要选 first lesson 所在的日期。
课程的实际开始日期是 January 13th（1月13日），这也是中级班的第一节课时间。
Do I have to bring my own towel? That’s right. We provide all participants with a swimming hat, though. Well, we do insist on it, actually. It helps the instructor to identify you。
排除法。客户问需不需要带 towel（毛巾），工作人员否定后引出 provide... a swimming hat。
游泳学校会为参与者提供一顶游泳 hat（泳帽），主要是为了方便教练识别不同的学员。
Oh, and don’t forget you need a 20p coin for the locker. Oh, okay. Right。
听到 20p coin 时立刻定位。卷面 Bring change for 对应原文的 you need a... for。
工作人员特别提醒，由于需要使用 locker（储物柜），学员需要自备 20 便士的零钱。
I really need to get some more exercise, and everyone says swimming is good for your health. Yes. And a lot of people find it improves their confidence, too。
听到 health 话题后，等待由并列连词 And 引出的第二个好处。
除了身体上的锻炼，游泳还能帮助许多人建立更好的 confidence（自信心）。
